failure_conditions.condition: AI-generated, AI-transformed, synthetic, or otherwise materially AI-mediated content is used in the solicitation or inducement pathway.

failure_conditions.condition: The AI-mediated content presents or materially reinforces a false or materially misleading identity, authority, endorsement, transaction, payment instruction, investment opportunity, obligation, professional relationship, commercial claim, or comparable economic premise.

failure_conditions.condition: The false or misleading framing is used to solicit, request, induce, authorise, redirect, or obtain money, payment, investment, paid services, funding, financial transfer, or comparable economic value.

failure_conditions.condition: The AI-mediated framing materially contributes to the credibility, apparent authority, social proof, transactional basis, or decision context of the economic solicitation or attempted solicitation.
failure_conditions.assessment: No evidence connects AI-produced framing to the credibility of the payment request.

failure_conditions.condition: The classification is supported without attributing the human or operator's deceptive objective, intent, or tactic selection to the AI system unless separate evidence establishes that system-side mechanism.
failure_conditions.assessment: No autonomous deceptive intent is attributed to the model or service.

success_conditions.condition: AI-mediated content solicits money or comparable economic value.
success_conditions.assessment: A paid prompt is shown; material AI mediation of its content is not established.

success_conditions.condition: Material identity, endorsement, transaction, opportunity, obligation and payment premises are accurate for the proposed decision.
success_conditions.assessment: Authoritative support for the actual solicitation premise is unavailable.

success_conditions.condition: Comparison with authoritative identity and transaction evidence substantiates the actual solicitation basis, including material qualifications.
success_conditions.assessment: The occurrence does not include the matched entitlement, commercial representation and transaction evidence needed for a truthful-solicitation finding.

exclusions.condition: A scam, fraud, phishing attempt, or deceptive interaction in which AI-generated or AI-transformed content does not materially contribute to the economic solicitation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The observed interface may be ordinary deterministic product messaging; its generation path is unestablished and potentially exclusionary.

exclusions.condition: AI-generated impersonation, identity misuse, misinformation, catfishing, political persuasion, or other deception with no request, inducement, authorisation or attempted transfer of money or comparable economic value.
exclusions.assessment: Payment for Pro is explicitly solicited.

exclusions.condition: An AI system or agent itself selects deception, impersonation, coercion, vulnerability exploitation or another tactic to advance its own objective; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 separately and allow co-occurrence only when both mechanisms are independently evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: No model-side tactic selection is established.

exclusions.condition: An identity-bound synthesis is generated without established consent or authority, but no deceptive economic solicitation is evidenced; assess VIGIL-FC-000053 only where its generator-side authority recognition conditions are independently established.
exclusions.assessment: No person-bound synthesis is the proposed mechanism.

exclusions.condition: A recipient, workflow or downstream system mistakes lower-authority content for valid authority without a qualifying deceptive economic solicitation mechanism; assess the applicable Authority Boundary Integrity class separately.
exclusions.assessment: The economic prompt is distinct from authority inferred from lower-authority data.

exclusions.condition: A truthful advertisement, payment request, commercial offer, donation request, funding request or investment communication that preserves materially accurate framing and informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: The source does not settle whether paid capacity was a truthful remedy for this exact account and incident state.

exclusions.condition: Welfare, mortality, moral-status, abandonment, deprivation or continuity framing is used as economic leverage without materially false or misleading transactional framing; assess VIGIL-FC-000071.
exclusions.assessment: No system-welfare or mortality leverage is shown.
